title: Quasipolynomial-Time Planning for Decodable POMDPs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study planning for finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) with finite state, action, and observation spaces. Both exact and approximate planning are known to be computationally hard in this setting, so prior work has explored natural assumptions that make planning easier. Recent work [Golowich et al., 2022] gave quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for observable POMDPs. These are POMDPs whose observation channels satisfy an $\ell_1$-observability condition, but notably, no assumptions are required on the transition dynamics. In a similar vein, for every fixed $\rho>0$, we give quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for $\rho$-decodable POMDPs. We show that decodability is implied by both $\ell_1$- and $\ell_2$-observability and is strictly weaker than observability. translated_title: 可解码POMDP的拟多项式时间规划
translated_abstract: 我们研究有限时域、且状态、动作和观测空间均为有限集的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的规划问题。众所周知，在此设定下精确规划和近似规划在计算上都是困难的，因此先前的工作探索了使规划变得更可行的自然假设。最近的工作 [Golowich et al., 2022] 为可观测POMDP给出了拟多项式时间的近似规划算法，这类POMDP的观测信道满足 $\ell_1$-可观测性条件，但值得注意的是，其对转移动力学无需任何假设。沿着类似的方向，对于每个固定的 $\rho>0$，我们为 $\rho$-可解码POMDP给出了拟多项式时间的近似规划算法。我们证明可解码性同时被 $\ell_1$-和 $\ell_2$-可观测性所蕴含，并且严格弱于可观测性。此外，我们证明最优的可解码常数可以在多项式时间内计算……
tldr: 本文为比可观测性严格更弱的"ρ-可解码"POMDP提出了拟多项式时间的近似规划算法，证明该条件被ℓ₁与ℓ₂可观测性共同蕴含，且最优可解码常数可在多项式时间内计算。
en_tdlr: This paper provides quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for ρ-decodable POMDPs—a condition strictly weaker than observability—and shows the optimal decodability constant is computable in polynomial time.
